question: What attainment did Tryambakāditya and his son achieve in the lineage?
premises: He leapt up into the sky.
His son likewise achieved the same.
inference: Both Tryambakāditya and his son attained perfection and ascended.
uncertainties: kham utpapāta: may indicate yogic ascent or passing away
plain_english: Being accomplished, he leapt up into the sky; his son also did likewise, likewise.
